description: Free legal-compliance check of a mobile app from its PUBLIC App Store (apps.apple.com) or Google Play (play.google.com) listing URL — no repo or developer-account access needed. Follows the privacy-policy link the developer declared on the listing, analyzes that page, and returns detected data processing, compliance recommendations, whether the EU AI Act applies, and suggestedAnswers for generate_policies. Read-only.

url.description: App Store or Google Play listing URL, e.g. https://apps.apple.com/app/id123456789 or https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.example.app.

name: check_store
title: Check app-store listing compliance
